transcript: Kiva let go of the line. She let go and stepped back on the bank without turning round, as Rhee had stepped back off a skin in the corn exchange yard, as Penhale's company man had stepped back on the hard at Gannett Creek. The purse was shut. Shut was shut. A shut purse is a sealed bag on this coast. The fold came over and came down. It came down on the mud and on the slack line, where it lay on the bank flat with a wet slap, and lay there steaming a yard from her knees.
